I didn't follow this game's development at all, so I went into it with no hype and got it for $40 with some gift cards. I bought it after a coworker recommended it as a Minecraft-in-space kind of game. I'm a console peasant, so I play on a PS4.

I've only played maybe 10 hours so far, but I've enjoyed it well enough. I'm not a space/sci-fi fanatic or anything, but it's a calming game to play after work and I really enjoy hunting for ruins and language stones. I've spent most all of my first 10 hours on my starter planet doing that, hunting for gold, and identifying plants/animals. I've already earned enough from my mining, sentinel destruction, and installation destruction to upgrade my ship to a 20 slotter, which was pretty rewarding.

I do hope they add some DLC for base building, but so far I'm feeling like I'm getting my money's worth. I'm sure it helped that I went in with low expectations, but I feel comfortable recommending it to others who are just looking for a low stress game to decompress with after work.

I do see how it's probably not exciting enough for the CoD or Destiny crowd, as it's far from combat-focused, and it doesn't seem to offer any depth for those who want really complex mechanics to master or sophisticated civilizations to conquer. It's really just a pretty Minecraft in space as far as I can tell, minus the depth of Minecraft's crafting. If that sounds okay to you, then you'd probably enjoy this game too. Otherwise, don't waste your time.
